title: turbina holubii
intro: Turbina holubii, commonly known as Ipomoea holubii or Morning Glory, is a plant species belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help in reducing swelling, pain, and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Turbina holubii include its ability to treat fever, headache, and cough, as well as its use as an anthelmintic to expel intestinal parasites. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
